entries.reason: The target M4 builds a twelve-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS plus a procedural-AABB BLAS and a twelve-instance TLAS, refits triangle/AABB/TLAS geometry, clones and compacts the triangle BLAS after an exact compacted-size report, serializes and deserializes BLAS/TLAS data with standard headers and exact TLAS pointer lists, and traverses deserialized structures after releasing every source D3D12 acceleration-structure resource. Inline RayQuery and DispatchRays cover filtered multi-collection inheritance/merging, collection lifetime, invalid-export rejection, state-object growth, local-root constant and GPU-resident SRV/UAV/CBV/sampler descriptor-table mirrors used by five 96-byte-stride local records, raygen, triangle any-hit/closest-hit, procedural intersection, callable, and depth-2 recursion. Mixed triangle/AABB geometry in one BLAS crashes the available Metal descriptor route; persistent cross-process reconstruction, new-library growth, and broader shader-table matrices remain unproven.

AS/MS pipeline streams, stage-specific CBV/SRV/UAV plus texture/sampler resources, 32 mesh lanes, sixteen-byte payloads, two dispatch groups, direct/indirect DispatchMesh, payload-selected SV_RenderTargetArrayIndex output into two independently read-back RTV array layers, a layered D32_FLOAT depth pass with one exact accepted and one exact rejected payload depth, exact layered additive color/alpha blending, and exact filled-versus-wireframe rasterization pass at runtime. Broader mixed render-state matrices, pipeline statistics, and broader shader/payload coverage remain required before reporting tier 1.
No work graph program object, backing memory, node dispatch, or Metal execution model is implemented.
No D3D12 video command list, decoder, encoder, processor, or VideoToolbox bridge is implemented in the DXMT D3D12 path.
Protected sessions currently return E_NOTIMPL or no-op and do not provide protected-memory semantics.
Device-side DSR factory behavior is not implemented or required for the current Metal backend.

A DXIL library creates a Metal linked-function pipeline with raygen, miss, triangle any-hit/closest-hit, procedural intersection/closest-hit, and callable exports. Stable identifiers preserve the Metal Shader Converter local-sampler field at bytes 16-23, keep alias hashes in the reserved tail, and execute a grown inherited hit-group alias through DispatchRays, including associated local-root constant and mirrored SRV/CBV reads, a mirrored sampler and static local sampler SampleLevel, and an exact UAV write from the shader record. Two filtered collections derived from one executable Metal table merge into a pipeline, reject a missing export, preserve renamed identifiers, survive every external collection release, and execute the full DispatchRays corpus. GPU-resident SRV/UAV/CBV and sampler descriptor-table mirrors execute through five 96-byte-stride local records; shader stack-size queries and configured pipeline stack-size retention are also behavior-proven. Independently linked collection merging, new-library growth, and complete stack/record-count/stride local-data shader-table matrices remain gated.

A four-byte AS-to-MS payload, object-stage root CBV and raw-buffer SRV, and object-stage dispatch pass readback; broader payload sizes, texture/UAV resources, barriers, and amplification patterns remain gated.
Node shaders are part of the unimplemented work graphs execution model.
Stream output has no compute-emulation path; PSO creation and format support must not advertise it.
Metal sparse backing is not implemented or probed; reserved resources must fail instead of falling back to committed allocation.

entries.api: D3D12 geometry shaders outside proven emulation
entries.reason: Linked SM5 vertex/geometry AIR now executes through a Metal object/mesh pipeline and passes triangle readback; broader topology, stream, resource, and captured-title coverage remains required before a general claim.

One behavior-identified hull/domain proof shape executes through native Metal tessellation and passes readback. General hull/domain shader conversion, patch layouts, partitioning/topologies, resources, and render-state matrices remain unsupported and are rejected rather than reported broadly.

purpose: Track explicit unsupported APIs so games are not misled by optimistic success returns.
